cohort: The study included 18 pregnant women with confirmed neurodevelopmental disorders and 21 matched controls with uncomplicated pregnancies.
finding: Pregnant women with neurodevelopmental disorders face a multidimensional vulnerability in maternity care, experiencing higher rates of various adverse outcomes, including pain, bleeding, mental health issues, prolonged labor, increased cesarean rates, reduced breastfeeding, and lower neonatal anthropometrics, alongside frequent communication barriers.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery occurred in 83.3% of women with neurodevelopmental disorders versus 23.8% of controls, often indicated by psychiatric recommendations.
birth_weight: Lower neonatal anthropometrics in the ND group
